cond_0001.intro: The Analyst I Quality will perform testing on the finished product, in-process, or raw material samples in either the chemistry or microbiology lab to provide analytical information to support the manufacturing process and ensure the product meets specification and consumer safety standards.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Technical/Functional:
Accurately and consistently perform routine testing in the QC lab. Conduct testing in accordance with SOP's. Perform routine maintenance and calibration procedures on laboratory equipment. Prepare and qualify reagents as required. Sample raw material and finished product containers. Assist in labeling off-quality material as needed. Analyze and report results via LIMS and communicate/present test results and pertinent information to appropriate persons. Position requires ability to operate on rotating shift schedule.
Quality:
Follow all standard lab procedures and testing methods. Assure lab equipment is kept clean and in good working order. Comply with CGMP, GLP, FSSC, and ISO 9001 standards, both in the laboratory and in the plant. Maintain accurate records of all test results and report them in a timely manner in alignment with the quality system. Ensure documentation and records are maintained according to plant procedures and the quality system. Suggest changes to procedures and methods as needed.
Safety/Health/Environment:
Conduct all lab procedures in a manner that protects the safety & health of self & other individuals. Wear appropriate Personal Protective Equipment (PPE). Assist in maintaining, at a high level, all laboratory safety equipment and cleanliness/housekeeping standards. Support the site behavioral based safety program by participating in observations and providing constructive feedback for safety improvement. Carry out safety risk assessments for lab activities. Ensure all work is conducted with respect to safety precautions, equipment safety devices. Conduct all work in compliance with systems for maintaining a safe workplace (Management of Change, Environmental Management System, PSM etc.). Take personal responsibility to raise safety concerns and be part of the resolution. Participate in plant safety initiatives. Ensures disposal of all laboratory wastes is in compliance with regulatory and plant guidelines.
Communication:
Proactively communicate issues and ideas for improvement. Ensure all key stakeholders in your areas of responsibility have required information in a timely manner. Effectively utilize all communication systems (telephone, voicemail, electronic mail, memos, posting) to stay informed and inform others as appropriate. Provide and/or respond to information requests in a timely and complete manner. Demonstrate an attitude of respect and professional interaction with others.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements:
Minimum High School Degree in chemical technology, microbiology, or related fields of study, or equivalent combination of education and experience.
6 Months to 2 years experience in a testing laboratory or equivalent.
Good math and analytical skills (ability to perform calculations).
Computer literacy with MS Office, email, Internet, etc.
Preferred Requirements:
Associates of Applied Science Degree in chemical technology, microbiology, or related fields of study.
Experience in a chemistry lab.
Familiarity with basic laboratory equipment and analytical testing procedures.
Familiarity with ISO 9001, FSSC 22000, and cGMPs.
Familiarity with LIMS (Laboratory Information Management System).
While we are interested in all qualified candidates with the potential to work in [Location masked], we are not able to sponsor visas. Additionally, to qualify for this position, you must be proficient in English, including reading, writing, and verbal communication.
cond_0001.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.

cond_0009.intro: The Analyst I Quality will work with the lab team to perform testing on finished product, in-process, or raw material samples in either the chemistry or microbiology lab. The role supports the manufacturing process by providing analytical information and helping ensure products meet specification and consumer safety standards.
cond_0009.responsibilities:
Technical/Functional:
Accurately and consistently perform routine testing in the QC lab in accordance with SOPs. Coordinate routine maintenance and calibration procedures on laboratory equipment. Prepare and qualify reagents as required. Work with team members to sample raw material and finished product containers. Assist in labeling off-quality material as needed. Analyze and share results via LIMS and communicate test results and pertinent information to appropriate persons. Position requires ability to operate on rotating shift schedule.
Quality:
Follow all standard lab procedures and testing methods. Help ensure lab equipment is kept clean and in good working order. Comply with CGMP, GLP, FSSC, and ISO 9001 standards, both in the laboratory and in the plant. Maintain accurate records of all test results and report them in a timely manner in alignment with the quality system. Ensure documentation and records are maintained according to plant procedures and the quality system. Suggest changes to procedures and methods as needed.
Safety/Health/Environment:
Conduct all lab procedures in a manner that protects the safety and health of self and other individuals. Wear appropriate Personal Protective Equipment (PPE). Assist in maintaining, at a high level, all laboratory safety equipment and cleanliness/housekeeping standards. Support the site behavioral based safety program by participating in observations and providing constructive feedback for safety improvement. Carry out safety risk assessments for lab activities. Ensure all work is conducted with respect to safety precautions and equipment safety devices. Conduct all work in compliance with systems for maintaining a safe workplace (Management of Change, Environmental Management System, PSM etc.). Take personal responsibility to raise safety concerns and be part of the resolution. Participate in plant safety initiatives. Ensures disposal of all laboratory wastes is in compliance with regulatory and plant guidelines.
Communication:
Proactively share issues and ideas for improvement with the team. Ensure all key stakeholders in your areas of responsibility have required information in a timely manner. Effectively utilize all communication systems (telephone, voicemail, electronic mail, memos, posting) to stay informed and inform others as appropriate. Provide and/or respond to information requests in a timely and complete manner. Demonstrate an attitude of respect and professional interaction with others.
cond_0009.requirements:
Minimum Requirements:
Minimum High School Degree in chemical technology, microbiology, or a related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience.
6 Months to 2 years experience in a testing laboratory or equivalent.
Good math and analytical skills (ability to perform calculations).
Computer literacy with MS Office, email, Internet, etc.
Preferred Requirements:
Associates of Applied Science Degree in chemical technology, microbiology, or related field.
Experience in a chemistry lab.
Familiarity with basic laboratory equipment and analytical testing procedures.
Familiarity with ISO 9001, FSSC 22000, and cGMPs.
Familiarity with LIMS (Laboratory Information Management System).
While we are interested in all qualified candidates with the potential to work in [Location masked], we are not able to sponsor visas. Additionally, to qualify for this position, you must be proficient in English, including reading, writing, and verbal communication.

cond_0271.intro: The Analyst I Quality will perform testing on the finished product, in-process, or raw material samples in either the chemistry or microbiology lab to provide analytical information to support the manufacturing process and ensure the product meets specification and consumer safety standards.
cond_0271.responsibilities:
Technical/Functional:
Accurately and consistently perform routine testing in the QC lab. Conduct testing in accordance with SOP's. Perform routine maintenance and calibration procedures on laboratory equipment. Prepare and qualify reagents as required. Sample raw material and finished product containers. Assist in labeling off-quality material as needed. Analyze and report results via LIMS and communicate/present test results and pertinent information to appropriate persons. Position requires ability to operate on rotating shift schedule.
Quality:
Follow all standard lab procedures and testing methods. Assure lab equipment is kept clean and in good working order. Comply with CGMP, GLP, FSSC, and ISO 9001 standards, both in the laboratory and in the plant. Maintain accurate records of all test results and report them in a timely manner in alignment with the quality system. Ensure documentation and records are maintained according to plant procedures and the quality system. Suggest changes to procedures and methods as needed.
Safety/Health/Environment:
Conduct all lab procedures in a manner that protects the safety & health of self & other individuals. Wear appropriate Personal Protective Equipment (PPE). Assist in maintaining, at a high level, all laboratory safety equipment and cleanliness/housekeeping standards. Support the site behavioral based safety program by participating in observations and providing constructive feedback for safety improvement. Carry out safety risk assessments for lab activities. Ensure all work is conducted with respect to safety precautions, equipment safety devices. Conduct all work in compliance with systems for maintaining a safe workplace (Management of Change, Environmental Management System, PSM etc.). Take personal responsibility to raise safety concerns and be part of the resolution. Participate in plant safety initiatives. Ensures disposal of all laboratory wastes is in compliance with regulatory and plant guidelines.
Communication:
Proactively communicate issues and ideas for improvement. Ensure all key stakeholders in your areas of responsibility have required information in a timely manner. Effectively utilize all communication systems (telephone, voicemail, electronic mail, memos, posting) to stay informed and inform others as appropriate. Provide and/or respond to information requests in a timely and complete manner. Demonstrate an attitude of respect and professional interaction with others.
cond_0271.requirements:

Minimum High School Degree in chemical technology, microbiology, or related fields of study, or equivalent combination of education and experience.

Good math and analytical skills (ability to perform calculations).
Computer literacy with MS Office, email, Internet, etc.
Preferred Requirements:
Associates of Applied Science Degree in chemical technology, microbiology, or related fields of study.

The role supports the manufacturing process by providing analytical information and helping ensure products meet specification and consumer safety standards.
cond_0279.responsibilities:
Technical/Functional:
Accurately and consistently perform routine testing in the QC lab in accordance with SOPs. Coordinate routine maintenance and calibration procedures on laboratory equipment. Prepare and qualify reagents as required. Work with team members to sample raw material and finished product containers. Assist in labeling off-quality material as needed. Analyze and share results via LIMS and communicate test results and pertinent information to appropriate persons. Position requires ability to operate on rotating shift schedule.
Quality:
Follow all standard lab procedures and testing methods. Help ensure lab equipment is kept clean and in good working order. Comply with CGMP, GLP, FSSC, and ISO 9001 standards, both in the laboratory and in the plant. Maintain accurate records of all test results and report them in a timely manner in alignment with the quality system. Ensure documentation and records are maintained according to plant procedures and the quality system. Suggest changes to procedures and methods as needed.
Safety/Health/Environment:
Conduct all lab procedures in a manner that protects the safety and health of self and other individuals. Wear appropriate Personal Protective Equipment (PPE). Assist in maintaining, at a high level, all laboratory safety equipment and cleanliness/housekeeping standards. Support the site behavioral based safety program by participating in observations and providing constructive feedback for safety improvement. Carry out safety risk assessments for lab activities. Ensure all work is conducted with respect to safety precautions and equipment safety devices. Conduct all work in compliance with systems for maintaining a safe workplace (Management of Change, Environmental Management System, PSM etc.). Take personal responsibility to raise safety concerns and be part of the resolution. Participate in plant safety initiatives. Ensures disposal of all laboratory wastes is in compliance with regulatory and plant guidelines.
Communication:
Proactively share issues and ideas for improvement with the team. Ensure all key stakeholders in your areas of responsibility have required information in a timely manner. Effectively utilize all communication systems (telephone, voicemail, electronic mail, memos, posting) to stay informed and inform others as appropriate. Provide and/or respond to information requests in a timely and complete manner. Demonstrate an attitude of respect and professional interaction with others.
cond_0279.requirements:
Minimum Requirements:
Minimum High School Degree in chemical technology, microbiology, or a related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience.
6 Months to 2 years experience in a testing laboratory or equivalent.
Good math and analytical skills (ability to perform calculations).
Computer literacy with MS Office, email, Internet, etc.
Preferred Requirements:
Associates of Applied Science Degree in chemical technology, microbiology, or related field.
Experience in a chemistry lab.
Familiarity with basic laboratory equipment and analytical testing procedures.
Familiarity with ISO 9001, FSSC 22000, and cGMPs.
Familiarity with LIMS (Laboratory Information Management System).
While we are interested in all qualified candidates with the potential to work in [Location masked], we are not able to sponsor visas. Additionally, to qualify for this position, you must be proficient in English, including reading, writing, and verbal communication.

cond_0296.intro: The Quality Analyst will execute testing on finished product, in-process, or raw material samples in either the chemistry or microbiology lab to deliver analytical information that supports the manufacturing process and ensures products meet specification and consumer safety standards.
cond_0296.responsibilities:
Technical/Functional:
Accurately and consistently execute routine testing in the QC lab. Conduct testing in accordance with SOPs. Perform routine maintenance and calibration procedures on laboratory equipment. Prepare and qualify reagents as required. Sample raw material and finished product containers. Take ownership of labeling off-quality material as needed. Analyze and report results via LIMS and directly communicate test results and pertinent information to appropriate persons. Position requires ability to operate on rotating shift schedule.
Quality:
Follow all standard lab procedures and testing methods. Ensure lab equipment is kept clean and in good working order. Comply with CGMP, GLP, FSSC, and ISO 9001 standards, both in the laboratory and in the plant. Maintain accurate records of all test results and report them in a timely manner in alignment with the quality system. Ensure documentation and records are maintained according to plant procedures and the quality system. Drive improvements by identifying and proposing changes to procedures and methods as needed.
Safety/Health/Environment:
Conduct all lab procedures in a manner that protects the safety and health of self and other individuals. Wear appropriate Personal Protective Equipment (PPE). Take ownership of maintaining all laboratory safety equipment and cleanliness/housekeeping standards at a high level. Lead participation in the site behavioral based safety program by conducting observations and delivering constructive feedback for safety improvement. Carry out safety risk assessments for lab activities. Ensure all work is conducted with respect to safety precautions and equipment safety devices. Conduct all work in compliance with systems for maintaining a safe workplace (Management of Change, Environmental Management System, PSM etc.). Take personal responsibility to raise safety concerns and drive resolution. Participate in plant safety initiatives. Ensure disposal of all laboratory wastes is in compliance with regulatory and plant guidelines.
Communication:
Proactively communicate issues and ideas for improvement. Ensure all key stakeholders in your areas of responsibility have required information in a timely manner. Effectively utilize all communication systems (telephone, voicemail, electronic mail, memos, posting) to stay informed and inform others as appropriate. Provide and/or respond to information requests in a timely and complete manner. Demonstrate an attitude of respect and professional interaction with others.
cond_0296.requirements:
Minimum Requirements:
High School Degree
6 Months to 2 years experience in a testing laboratory or equivalent
Good math and analytical skills (ability to perform calculations)
Computer literacy with MS Office, email, Internet, etc.
Proficiency in English, including reading, writing, and verbal communication
Preferred Requirements:
Associates of Applied Science Degree in chemical technology, microbiology, or related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience
Experience in a chemistry lab
Familiarity with basic laboratory equipment and analytical testing procedures
Familiarity with ISO 9001, FSSC 22000, and cGMPs

cond_0305.intro: The Quality Analyst will execute testing on finished product, in-process, or raw material samples in either the chemistry or microbiology lab to deliver analytical information that supports the manufacturing process and ensures products meet specification and consumer safety standards.
cond_0305.responsibilities:
Technical/Functional:
Accurately and consistently execute routine testing in the QC lab. Conduct testing in accordance with SOP's. Perform routine maintenance and calibration procedures on laboratory equipment. Prepare and qualify reagents as required. Sample raw material and finished product containers. Label off-quality material as needed. Analyze and report results via LIMS and communicate test results and pertinent information to appropriate persons. Position requires ability to operate on rotating shift schedule.
Quality:
Follow all standard lab procedures and testing methods. Ensure lab equipment is kept clean and in good working order. Comply with CGMP, GLP, FSSC, and ISO 9001 standards, both in the laboratory and in the plant. Maintain accurate records of all test results and report them in a timely manner in alignment with the quality system. Ensure documentation and records are maintained according to plant procedures and the quality system. Drive changes to procedures and methods as needed.
Safety/Health/Environment:
Conduct all lab procedures in a manner that protects the safety & health of self & other individuals. Wear appropriate Personal Protective Equipment (PPE). Maintain, at a high level, all laboratory safety equipment and cleanliness/housekeeping standards. Support the site behavioral based safety program by participating in observations and providing constructive feedback for safety improvement. Carry out safety risk assessments for lab activities. Ensure all work is conducted with respect to safety precautions, equipment safety devices. Conduct all work in compliance with systems for maintaining a safe workplace (Management of Change, Environmental Management System, PSM etc.). Take personal responsibility to raise safety concerns and lead resolution. Participate in plant safety initiatives. Ensure disposal of all laboratory wastes is in compliance with regulatory and plant guidelines.
Communication:
Proactively communicate issues and ideas for improvement. Ensure all key stakeholders in your areas of responsibility have required information in a timely manner. Effectively utilize all communication systems (telephone, voicemail, electronic mail, memos, posting) to stay informed and inform others as appropriate. Provide and/or respond to information requests in a timely and complete manner. Demonstrate an attitude of respect and professional interaction with others.
cond_0305.requirements:
Minimum High School Degree with Associates of Applied Science Degree preferred in chemical technology, microbiology, or related fields of study or equivalent combination of education and experience.
6 Months to 2 years experience in a testing laboratory or equivalent with experience in a chemistry lab preferred.
Familiarity with basic laboratory equipment and analytical testing procedures preferred.
Good math and analytical skills (ability to perform calculations).
Computer literacy with MS Office, email, Internet, etc.
Familiarity with ISO 9001, FSSC 22000, and cGMPs desired.
Familiarity with LIMS (Laboratory Information Management System) desired.
While we are interested in all qualified candidates with the potential to work in [Location masked], we are not able to sponsor visas. Additionally, to qualify for this position, you must be proficient in English, including reading, writing, and verbal communication.

cond_0392.intro: The Analyst I Quality will perform testing on the finished product, in-process, or raw material samples in either the chemistry or microbiology lab to provide analytical information to support the manufacturing process and ensure the product meets specification and consumer safety standards. People usually grow into this role over time as they build experience with lab testing and quality procedures.
cond_0392.responsibilities:
Technical/Functional:
Accurately and consistently perform routine testing in the QC lab. Conduct testing in accordance with SOP's. Perform routine maintenance and calibration procedures on laboratory equipment. Prepare and qualify reagents as required. Sample raw material and finished product containers. Assist in labeling off-quality material as needed. Analyze and report results via LIMS and communicate/present test results and pertinent information to appropriate persons. Position requires ability to operate on rotating shift schedule.
Quality:
Follow all standard lab procedures and testing methods. Assure lab equipment is kept clean and in good working order. Comply with CGMP, GLP, FSSC, and ISO 9001 standards, both in the laboratory and in the plant. Maintain accurate records of all test results and report them in a timely manner in alignment with the quality system. Ensure documentation and records are maintained according to plant procedures and the quality system. Suggest changes to procedures and methods as needed.
Safety/Health/Environment:
Conduct all lab procedures in a manner that protects the safety & health of self & other individuals. Wear appropriate Personal Protective Equipment (PPE). Assist in maintaining, at a high level, all laboratory safety equipment and cleanliness/housekeeping standards. Support the site behavioral based safety program by participating in observations and providing constructive feedback for safety improvement. Carry out safety risk assessments for lab activities. Ensure all work is conducted with respect to safety precautions, equipment safety devices. Conduct all work in compliance with systems for maintaining a safe workplace (Management of Change, Environmental Management System, PSM etc.). Take personal responsibility to raise safety concerns and be part of the resolution. Participate in plant safety initiatives. Ensures disposal of all laboratory wastes is in compliance with regulatory and plant guidelines.
Communication:
Proactively communicate issues and ideas for improvement. Ensure all key stakeholders in your areas of responsibility have required information in a timely manner. Effectively utilize all communication systems (telephone, voicemail, electronic mail, memos, posting) to stay informed and inform others as appropriate. Provide and/or respond to information requests in a timely and complete manner. Demonstrate an attitude of respect and professional interaction with others.
cond_0392.requirements:
Minimum High School Degree with Associates of Applied Science Degree preferred in chemical technology, microbiology, or related fields of study or equivalent combination of education and experience.
6 Months to 2 years experience in a testing laboratory or equivalent with experience in a chemistry lab preferred.
Familiarity with basic laboratory equipment and analytical testing procedures preferred.
Good math and analytical skills (ability to perform calculations).
Computer literacy with MS Office, email, Internet, etc.
Familiarity with ISO 9001, FSSC 22000, and cGMPs desired.
Familiarity with LIMS (Laboratory Information Management System) desired.
While we are interested in all qualified candidates with the potential to work in [Location masked], we are not able to sponsor visas. Additionally, to qualify for this position, you must be proficient in English, including reading, writing, and verbal communication.

People usually grow into this role over time as they build experience with lab testing and analytical work.
cond_0401.responsibilities:
Technical/Functional:
Accurately and consistently perform routine testing in the QC lab. Conduct testing in accordance with SOP's. Perform routine maintenance and calibration procedures on laboratory equipment. Prepare and qualify reagents as required. Sample raw material and finished product containers. Assist in labeling off-quality material as needed. Analyze and report results via LIMS and communicate/present test results and pertinent information to appropriate persons. Position requires ability to operate on rotating shift schedule.
Quality:
Follow all standard lab procedures and testing methods. Assure lab equipment is kept clean and in good working order. Comply with CGMP, GLP, FSSC, and ISO 9001 standards, both in the laboratory and in the plant. Maintain accurate records of all test results and report them in a timely manner in alignment with the quality system. Ensure documentation and records are maintained according to plant procedures and the quality system. Suggest changes to procedures and methods as needed.
Safety/Health/Environment:
Conduct all lab procedures in a manner that protects the safety & health of self & other individuals. Wear appropriate Personal Protective Equipment (PPE). Assist in maintaining, at a high level, all laboratory safety equipment and cleanliness/housekeeping standards. Support the site behavioral based safety program by participating in observations and providing constructive feedback for safety improvement. Carry out safety risk assessments for lab activities. Ensure all work is conducted with respect to safety precautions, equipment safety devices. Conduct all work in compliance with systems for maintaining a safe workplace (Management of Change, Environmental Management System, PSM etc.). Take personal responsibility to raise safety concerns and be part of the resolution. Participate in plant safety initiatives. Ensures disposal of all laboratory wastes is in compliance with regulatory and plant guidelines.
Communication:
Proactively communicate issues and ideas for improvement. Ensure all key stakeholders in your areas of responsibility have required information in a timely manner. Effectively utilize all communication systems (telephone, voicemail, electronic mail, memos, posting) to stay informed and inform others as appropriate. Provide and/or respond to information requests in a timely and complete manner. Demonstrate an attitude of respect and professional interaction with others.
cond_0401.requirements:
Minimum Requirements:
Minimum High School Degree in chemical technology, microbiology, or a related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience.
6 Months to 2 years experience in a testing laboratory or equivalent.
Good math and analytical skills (ability to perform calculations).
Computer literacy with MS Office, email, Internet, etc.
Preferred Requirements:
Associates of Applied Science Degree in chemical technology, microbiology, or a related field.
Experience in a chemistry lab.
Familiarity with basic laboratory equipment and analytical testing procedures.
Familiarity with ISO 9001, FSSC 22000, and cGMPs.
Familiarity with LIMS (Laboratory Information Management System).
While we are interested in all qualified candidates with the potential to work in [Location masked], we are not able to sponsor visas. Additionally, to qualify for this position, you must be proficient in English, including reading, writing, and verbal communication.

cond_0506.intro: The Quality Analyst will perform testing on finished product, in-process, or raw material samples in either the chemistry or microbiology lab to provide analytical information to support the manufacturing process and ensure the product meets specification and consumer safety standards.
cond_0506.responsibilities:
Technical/Functional:
Accurately and consistently perform routine testing in the QC lab. Conduct testing in accordance with SOP's. Perform routine maintenance and calibration procedures on laboratory equipment. Prepare and qualify reagents as required. Sample raw material and finished product containers. Assist in labeling off-quality material as needed. Analyze and report results via LIMS and communicate/present test results and pertinent information to appropriate persons. Position requires ability to operate on rotating shift schedule.
Quality:
Follow all standard lab procedures and testing methods. Assure lab equipment is kept clean and in good working order. Comply with CGMP, GLP, FSSC, and ISO 9001 standards, both in the laboratory and in the plant. Maintain accurate records of all test results and report them in a timely manner in alignment with the quality system. Ensure documentation and records are maintained according to plant procedures and the quality system. Suggest changes to procedures and methods as needed.
Safety/Health/Environment:
Conduct all lab procedures in a manner that protects the safety & health of self & other individuals. Wear appropriate Personal Protective Equipment (PPE). Assist in maintaining, at a high level, all laboratory safety equipment and cleanliness/housekeeping standards. Support the site behavioral based safety program by participating in observations and providing constructive feedback for safety improvement. Carry out safety risk assessments for lab activities. Ensure all work is conducted with respect to safety precautions, equipment safety devices. Conduct all work in compliance with systems for maintaining a safe workplace (Management of Change, Environmental Management System, PSM etc.). Take personal responsibility to raise safety concerns and be part of the resolution. Participate in plant safety initiatives. Ensures disposal of all laboratory wastes is in compliance with regulatory and plant guidelines.
Communication:
Proactively communicate issues and ideas for improvement. Ensure all key stakeholders in your areas of responsibility have required information in a timely manner. Effectively utilize all communication systems (telephone, voicemail, electronic mail, memos, posting) to stay informed and inform others as appropriate. Provide and/or respond to information requests in a timely and complete manner. Demonstrate an attitude of respect and professional interaction with others.
cond_0506.requirements:
Minimum Requirements:
High School Degree; Bachelor's degree in chemical technology, microbiology, or a related field required; advanced degree strongly preferred.
Minimum 2 years of demonstrated expertise in a testing laboratory, with a proven track record in chemistry lab work.
Strong command of basic laboratory equipment and analytical testing procedures.
Advanced math and analytical skills, including the ability to perform complex calculations.
Proficiency in MS Office, email, and Internet-based tools.
Preferred Requirements:
Deep knowledge of ISO 9001, FSSC 22000, and cGMP standards.
Solid understanding of LIMS (Laboratory Information Management System).
We are interested in all qualified candidates with the potential to work in [Location masked]; however, we are not able to sponsor visas. To qualify for this position, you must be proficient in English, including reading, writing, and verbal communication.

cond_0588.responsibilities:
Technical/Functional:
Accurately and consistently perform routine testing in the QC lab. Conduct testing in accordance with SOP's. Perform routine maintenance and calibration procedures on laboratory equipment. Analyze and report results via LIMS and communicate/present test results and pertinent information to appropriate persons. Position requires ability to operate on rotating shift schedule.
Quality:
Follow all standard lab procedures and testing methods. Assure lab equipment is kept clean and in good working order. Comply with CGMP, GLP, FSSC, and ISO 9001 standards, both in the laboratory and in the plant. Maintain accurate records of all test results and report them in a timely manner in alignment with the quality system. Ensure documentation and records are maintained according to plant procedures and the quality system. Suggest changes to procedures and methods as needed.
Safety/Health/Environment:
Conduct all lab procedures in a manner that protects the safety & health of self & other individuals. Wear appropriate Personal Protective Equipment (PPE). Assist in maintaining, at a high level, all laboratory safety equipment and cleanliness/housekeeping standards. Support the site behavioral based safety program by participating in observations and providing constructive feedback for safety improvement. Carry out safety risk assessments for lab activities. Ensure all work is conducted with respect to safety precautions, equipment safety devices. Conduct all work in compliance with systems for maintaining a safe workplace (Management of Change, Environmental Management System, PSM etc.). Take personal responsibility to raise safety concerns and be part of the resolution. Participate in plant safety initiatives. Ensures disposal of all laboratory wastes is in compliance with regulatory and plant guidelines.

Proactively communicate issues and ideas for improvement. Ensure all key stakeholders in your areas of responsibility have required information in a timely manner. Effectively utilize all communication systems (telephone, voicemail, electronic mail, memos, posting) to stay informed and inform others as appropriate. cond_0606.intro: The Analyst I Quality will perform testing on the finished product, in-process, or raw material samples in either the chemistry or microbiology lab to provide analytical information to support the manufacturing process and ensure the product meets specification and consumer safety standards.
cond_0606.responsibilities:
Technical/Functional:
Accurately and consistently perform routine testing in the QC lab. Conduct testing in accordance with SOP's. Perform routine maintenance and calibration procedures on laboratory equipment. Prepare and qualify reagents as required. Sample raw material and finished product containers. Assist in labeling off-quality material as needed. Analyze and report results via LIMS and communicate/present test results and pertinent information to appropriate persons. Position requires ability to operate on rotating shift schedule.
Quality:
Follow all standard lab procedures and testing methods. Assure lab equipment is kept clean and in good working order. Comply with CGMP, GLP, FSSC, and ISO 9001 standards, both in the laboratory and in the plant. Maintain accurate records of all test results and report them in a timely manner in alignment with the quality system. Ensure documentation and records are maintained according to plant procedures and the quality system. Suggest changes to procedures and methods as needed.
Safety/Health/Environment:
Conduct all lab procedures in a manner that protects the safety & health of self & other individuals. Wear appropriate Personal Protective Equipment (PPE). Assist in maintaining, at a high level, all laboratory safety equipment and cleanliness/housekeeping standards. Support the site behavioral based safety program by participating in observations and providing constructive feedback for safety improvement. Carry out safety risk assessments for lab activities. Ensure all work is conducted with respect to safety precautions, equipment safety devices. Conduct all work in compliance with systems for maintaining a safe workplace (Management of Change, Environmental Management System, PSM etc.). Take personal responsibility to raise safety concerns and be part of the resolution. Participate in plant safety initiatives. Ensures disposal of all laboratory wastes is in compliance with regulatory and plant guidelines.

Proactively communicate issues and ideas for improvement. Ensure all key stakeholders in your areas of responsibility have required information in a timely manner. Effectively utilize all communication systems (telephone, voicemail, electronic mail, memos, posting) to stay informed and inform others as appropriate.
